# CONF-017: Results identify the server in _meta serverInfo

| Severity | Applies to | Spec section |
|---|---|---|
| warn | modern era, stdio, http | [2026-07-28/basic/index#meta](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic/index#meta) |

Calls server/discover and, if tools are declared, tools/list. Servers SHOULD include io.modelcontextprotocol/serverInfo in every result's _meta.

From the command line: `mcpprobe checks explain CONF-017`. To leave it out of a run, add `"CONF-017"` to `[checks] disable` in [mcpprobe.toml](../configuration.md); to change how much it counts, use `severity_overrides`.
